logline: A pampered English aristocrat abandons his comfortable life to become a pirate captain in the early 18th century, stumbling into the orbit of the real-world Blackbeard - and a romance neither of them expected.

renewal.note: Cancelled by Max in January 2024 after two seasons, despite strong critical reception and devoted fan advocacy for a third season.

bollymeter.basis: 94% on Rotten Tomatoes from 48 critics with 95% audience approval. Critics praised the gentle tone, queer romance, and the surprising chemistry between Rhys Darby and Taika Waititi.

pull_quotes.text: A gentleman pirate may not be a skilled plunderer, but he can seemingly steal a heart.

seasons.review_body: Our Flag Means Death launched on HBO Max in March 2022 and quietly became one of streaming's most beloved cult hits. The premise sounds like a comedy pitch - a foppish English aristocrat attempts to reinvent himself as a pirate - but creator David Jenkins used the 18th-century setting for something unexpectedly tender: a queer romance between Rhys Darby's helplessly enthusiastic Stede Bonnet and Taika Waititi's world-weary Blackbeard. Critics gave Season 1 a 94% Rotten Tomatoes score from 48 reviews. The show's gentle sensibility - cosy rather than satirical, inclusive rather than exclusive - generated a passionate fan community that rewarded its queer representation with genuine cultural affection. The 10-episode first season built to a finale that earned its emotional stakes.

episode_reviews.title: Pilot
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Stede Bonnet introduces himself to the Caribbean as the Gentleman Pirate - incompetent, warm-hearted, and utterly genuine. The premiere establishes the show's comedic register and its surprising emotional sincerity within the first ten minutes.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Stede's crew discovering his extraordinary collection of books - the image that defines the show's central character and its tender approach to aspiration.

episode_reviews.title: The Best Revenge Is Living Well
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Blackbeard properly enters Stede's life and their dynamic crystallises. The episode where the show's central romance becomes undeniable - and where Taika Waititi's performance takes a surprising emotional turn.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Blackbeard and Stede's first genuine conversation - two people who have performed versions of themselves finally meeting someone who sees through the performance.

episode_reviews.title: Legend of Gentleman Pirate
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The season finale earns every emotional beat the show has been building toward. The central romance reaches a crisis point that devastated the fan community and made Season 2 a cultural necessity.
episode_reviews.the_moment: A choice made by someone running from himself - and the devastating consequences that follow.

bollymeter.basis: 96% on Rotten Tomatoes - higher than Season 1; critics praised the emotional resolution of the central romance and the show's expanded ensemble work.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 arrived on Max in October 2023 with a 96% Rotten Tomatoes score that exceeded Season 1 - the show at its most confident and emotionally committed. The eight-episode run resolved the Season 1 cliffhanger and deepened every relationship in the ensemble. Blackbeard's arc became genuinely surprising in its dramatic range, while the supporting crew - Frenchie, Lucius, Jim, Oluwande - received expanded storylines that rewarded the loyalty Season 1 had cultivated. The news of the cancellation in January 2024 hit the show's devoted community particularly hard given the critical excellence of this second run and the unresolved narrative threads it left. The two seasons together remain a complete and satisfying love story.
seasons.season_over_season: Exceeds Season 1 in both confidence and critical score; the cancellation after this is genuinely frustrating.

episode_reviews.title: Impossible Birds
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Season 2 opens by checking in on where the Season 1 finale left each character - and immediately demonstrates that the emotional stakes have been raised rather than reset. Blackbeard's deterioration is the season's most unexpected dramatic thread.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The reunion between Stede and Blackbeard that the Season 1 cliffhanger made the audience wait a year for.
